documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-09-07-os-osz-pro-procesni: On 7 September 2026, Dušan Dvořák asked the Prostějov District Court and District Public Prosecutor’s Office for a precise procedural explanation of which original criminal case would be heard under files 15 Nt 3104/2026 and 15 Nt 3106/2026.
documents.doc-cz-ekk-2026-09-11-msp-cia-thc-dohled: On 11 September 2026, the Educational Cannabis Clinic submitted a filing to the Ministry of Justice and the Czech Accreditation Institute seeking review of forensic and laboratory practice in cannabis testing and quantitative THC determination, including sampling, homogenisation, THC/THCA, decarboxylation, validation, measurement uncertainty and accreditation scope.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-09-13-os-osz-pro-doplneni: A filing dated 13 September 2026 supplemented the Prostějov renewal proceedings 15 Nt 3104/2026 and 15 Nt 3106/2026 and related public-prosecution files, referring to the new 11 September Ministry/Accreditation filing and the 13 September closing communication to the Supreme Public Prosecutor and Czech Television.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-09-13-ks-ksz-vsz-doplneni: A filing dated 13 September 2026 supplemented Brno Regional Court complaint proceedings 9 To 315/2026 and 9 To 316/2026 and related supervision/review branches before the Olomouc High and Brno Regional Public Prosecutor’s Offices.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-09-13-nsz-ct-zaverecne-sd: The 13 September 2026 closing communication followed the pre-action demand to the Supreme Public Prosecutor’s Office and the continuing complaint to Czech Television and its Council; it identified the 11 September article and the Ministry/Accreditation filing as new records.
documents.doc-cz-mv-2026-09-14-mv-139593-3-tp-2026: On 14 September 2026 the Ministry of the Interior dismissed the appeal dated 24 August 2026 and confirmed the Moravian-Silesian Regional Police decision of 20 August 2026, ref. KRPT-203594-8/ČJ-2026-0700KR, concerning partial refusal of an information request. The decision states that no further administrative appeal is available.
documents.doc-cz-ms-pha-2026-09-14-9-ad-12-2026-7: On 14 September 2026 the Prague Municipal Court rejected the second identical intervention action in case 9 Ad 12/2026 because an earlier identical action filed on 31 August 2026 remains pending as 15 Ad 14/2026. The rejection of 9 Ad 12/2026 therefore does not terminate the earlier 15 Ad 14/2026 proceeding. The order allows a cassation complaint within two weeks of service; the service date is not recorded here.
documents.doc-cz-vsz-olo-2026-09-15-3-vzn-239-2026: On 15 September 2026 the Olomouc High Public Prosecutor’s Office explained how it handled submissions dated 15 and 24 August and 2, 3 and 13 September. It noted or had forwarded several filings and stated that supervision over district public prosecutor’s offices belongs to the directly superior regional offices; the 13 September filing was therefore noted without further measure at the High Office.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-09-16-os-ks-brno-predzase: The 16 September 2026 joint evidentiary and procedural supplement was addressed to the Prostějov District Court in files 15 Nt 3104/2026 and 15 Nt 3106/2026 and to the Brno Regional Court in files 9 To 315/2026 and 9 To 316/2026, following the Prostějov court clarifications of 14 September.
